summary: arp_hosttest.c and packet_hosttest.c with five faults in private copies of rach2/sys/network/arp/arp.c and ip/ip.c; the test runs both

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && cp tests/host/arp_hosttest.c tests/host/packet_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ && for t in arp packet; do ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat ${WORK}/t/tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || exit; done
s=0; for t in arp_hosttest packet_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s

faults.name: hardware-length
faults.summary: an ARP packet whose hardware address length is not 6 is taken

lines: invalid ARP layout changed a mapping

faults.name: protocol-length
faults.summary: an ARP packet whose protocol address length is not 4 is taken

lines: invalid ARP layout changed a mapping

faults.name: network-interface
faults.summary: the network address of an interface is judged by the first interface's address

lines: second interface network address was cached

faults.name: broadcast-interface
faults.summary: the broadcast address of an interface is judged by the first interface's

lines: another interface broadcast address was rejected

faults.name: ip-mtu
faults.summary: an IP payload may be 1500 bytes, header aside

lines: oversize IP payload returns -EMSGSIZE on every path
